title: URSA: Chemistry-Aware Benchmark for Utilitarian Retrosynthesis Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2607.04688v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Synthesis planning aiming to find pathways of reactions for a target molecule is one of the most important and challenging tasks in drug discovery. Recent progress has produced both specialized deep-learning retrosynthesis systems and general-purpose large language models, but objective comparison remains difficult due to the lack of flexible, chemically interpretable benchmarking protocols. In the current study, we are introducing the URSA (Utilitarian RetroSynthesis Assessment) evaluation framework that provides the opportunity to benchmark the synthetic routes not only from a formal perspective, such as convergence to commercially available starting materials, but also from a chemical plausibility perspective, mimicking the way expert chemists evaluate the reactions and routes. The study covers a comprehensive evaluation of both conventional end-to-end retrosynthesis solutions and LLMs for the synthesis planning task on a se

translated_title: URSA：面向实用性逆合成评估的化学感知基准
translated_abstract: 合成规划旨在为目标分子寻找可行的反应路径，是药物发现中最重要且最具挑战性的任务之一。近期的进展催生了专用的深度学习逆合成系统和通用的大型语言模型，但由于缺乏灵活且具备化学可解释性的基准测试协议，对它们进行客观比较仍然十分困难。在本研究中，我们提出了URSA（实用性逆合成评估）评估框架，该框架不仅能够从形式角度（例如是否收敛到可商业购买的起始原料）对合成路线进行基准评估，还能从化学合理性角度进行评估，模拟专家化学家评估反应与路线的方式。该研究对传统端到端逆合成解决方案和大语言模型在合成规划任务上进行了全面评估（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: URSA提出了一个化学感知的逆合成评估基准框架，首次从形式指标（如收敛到商业可得起始原料）和模拟专家化学家判断的化学合理性两个维度，对端到端逆合成模型与大语言模型进行客观、可解释的比较评估。
en_tdlr: URSA introduces a chemistry-aware benchmarking framework that evaluates synthetic routes both formally (e.g., convergence to commercially available starting materials) and in terms of chemical plausibility mimicking expert chemists, enabling objective and interpretable comparison between end-to-end retrosynthesis systems and large language models.
